newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt extends deadline for BOT airport project.
newsitem.headline: Egypt extends deadline for BOT airport project.

text.p: Egypt's Civil Aviation Authority said on Wednesday it had postponed until May 31 the deadline for tenders to build an international airport at El Alamein under a BOT (build, operate, transfer) formula.
It is the third postponement of the procedure, previously set for December 31, then January 30 and then March 31.
The El Alamein airport project, on the Mediterranean coast west of Alexandria, is one of seven Egypt is offering to the private sector under the BOT formula.
The most advanced of them is for an airport at Marsa Alam on the Red Sea coast. The authorities have been negotiating details of that project with a Kuwaiti company.
